messages:
james: Quick check-in after the outage postmortem. We agreed to fold several incident-driven tests into the delivery pipeline. Who can pick up instrumentation + test owners?

leila: I can take instrumentation. Plan: add a histogram for request interarrival times and tag traces with incident_id. Will send a PR with dashboard panels. ETA: Thu EOD.

omar: I'll own the regression suite addition. We'll convert the failing user prompts to a small guarded test and add it to nightly canary. ETA: 3 business days.

nina: I can handle load-profile reproduction. Suggest we capture the burst shape and build a parametrized gatling scenario. Prototype by next Tue.

james: Nice. Two extra asks: 1) add a deterministic seed and recorded KV hit-rate to tests; 2) make the regression test non-blocking for dev merges but blocking for release builds.

leila: For instrumentation, I'll add a header field x-incident-id and ensure sampling is 100% for regression runs. Also adding an alert rule when 95th latency delta > 30% vs baseline.

omar: For the regression harness I'll add metadata: incident_id, original_response_snippet, and expected_behavior. That way evals can auto-score and we can triage regressions quicker.

ci-bot: Created issues: TG-556 (telemetry + dashboard), EV-778 (regression test + harness), LD-990 (load profile). Links: https://redwood.internal/issue/TG-556, https://redwood.internal/issue/EV-778, https://redwood.internal/issue/LD-990

nina: Load config example I'll use:
```
{scenario: 'burst', users: [10,100,300], ramp: '30s', hold: '2m', kv_hit_rate: 0.85}
```
I'll parameterize sequence lengths too.

james: Good. For ownership over time: proposal: remediation owner for 60 days post-incident, then handoff to platform-maintainers. Quarterly review of any recurring incidents. Agree?

leila: Agree. Also recommend tagging tests in the repo with "incident-driven" and referencing the ticket so we can filter and run targeted suites.

omar: I'll make EV-778 non-flaky by adding retries + golden thresholds. Will also wire it into the canary job but not the fast CI.

james: I'll create a swimlane card in the delivery board and add the 60-day review checkpoint. Also will add a recurring calendar: "Incident-driven test review" every Wednesday for 6 weeks.

ops-bot: Note: scheduled canary runs updated to include EV-778 starting at 2171200000.

leila: I'll open PR for TG-556 today and attach panel screenshots.

omar: PR for EV-778 by tomorrow; will add run tags and incident metadata.

nina: LD-990 spike prototype by next Tue, will include a recorded trace for determinism.

james: Please estimate effort in the tickets: <3d or 3-7d. I'll mark them release blockers if not complete by their due dates.

leila: TG-556 set to ~1.5d.

omar: EV-778 set to ~3d.

nina: LD-990 set to ~4d.

james: Great. I'll summarize to the postmortem and close the loop. Ping here if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
